evidence_rules: 1955–1992 is an explicitly low-confidence pre-association baseline derived from the ITF-recorded 1993 foundation year.
The 1993 association foundation and 2012 OTF membership are separately time-gated.
The 2022 West Pacific junior pathway is development/competition evidence, not an outcome-based rating target.
The 2026 OTF federation profile is current-only.
Small-state institutional continuity is not treated as world-leading participation or elite depth.
